items.control_name: Enforce Google Enterprise Foundations Blueprint Folder Hierarchy
items.description: The GCP Organization must deploy standardized top-level folders: Common, SharedServices, Production, Non-Production, and Sandbox.
items.current_value: 4 top-level folders configured according to Google Enterprise Blueprint
items.recommended_value: Standardized 4-tier folder hierarchy with dedicated IAM inheritance boundaries
items.remediation_notes: Prevent creation of ad-hoc root-level projects outside designated folders.

items.control_name: Enforce Shared VPC Architecture for Centralized Network Management
items.description: Workload projects must attach to a Shared VPC managed by a centralized networking/security host project.
items.current_value: Shared VPC Host 'proj-net-hub-01' attached to 14 production service projects
items.recommended_value: 100% of production workloads reside inside Shared VPC subnets
items.remediation_notes: Review subnet IAM permissions for Service Project admins.

items.control_name: Enforce VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) Perimeters around Sensitive Data Services
items.description: VPC Service Controls must prevent data exfiltration by enforcing service perimeters around BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL.
items.current_value: VPC-SC Perimeter 'perimeter-prod-core' active in Enforce mode
items.recommended_value: VPC-SC perimeter active across 100% of production projects
items.remediation_notes: Maintain minimal ingress/egress rules using Access Levels.

items.control_name: Centralized Billing Data Export to SecOps BigQuery Dataset
items.description: Detailed billing and resource usage exports must be routed to an immutable BigQuery dataset for anomaly and cost-abuse detection.
items.recommended_value: Active BigQuery billing export with alert rules for cost spikes > 50%
items.remediation_notes: Monitor anomaly alerts in Cloud Billing budget notifications.
